reviewer: Same authoring assistant; additional references are independent of the frozen Wiktionary extraction, but the reviewer is not independent.
method: Read all 1500 base entries (meaning, displayed POS, pattern and inflection rows); read all 53 authored note entries and the usage overrides. This is linguistic screening, not 1500 independent dictionary lookups.
Inspect generator assumptions and all 10 invariant noun plurals, all adjective feminine outputs, and all five noun sections marked uncountable by the frozen extract.
Consult DLE/DPD for the specific ambiguities and unchanged decisions recorded below; compare four full irregular present tables by person.
Change only documented errors, misleading omissions/patterns or unsupported sense-specific teaching rows. Preserve valid variants.

changes.reason: A monosyllable ending in -s takes -es. The mapping contains the headword, which the old rule mistook for a plural.
The happen sense has a thing/event as subject. DLE marks it intransitive and restricts it to third persons, not subjectless. Remove the source-derived impersonal label.
